tasks.extracted: Of 100 residue samples, 66 contained xylazine above the GC-MS/MS limit of detection. At or above 1 μg/ml: 37 of 38 positive, 1 negative (Sample 63, 2 μg/ml); below 1 μg/ml: 6 of 28 positive, 10 faint negative, 12 negative; not detected: 0 of 34 positive, 1 faint negative, 33 negative. Sensitivity 0.974, specificity 1.00 and accuracy 0.986, calculated only on samples above the cut-off or without xylazine. Editors' calculation on the study card: Wilson 95% CI 0.865–0.995 (sensitivity) and 0.898–1.000 (specificity); 43 of 66 xylazine-containing samples positive (0.65, 0.53–0.76).
